configurations.name: api-example-env
runtimeArgs: export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.21.0/bin:$PATH"; eval "$(cd apps/api && node_modules/.bin/tsx src/cli/generate-qr-keys.ts | sed 's/^/export /')" && NODE_ENV=development API_URL=http://localhost:3000 WEB_URL=http://localhost:5173 DATABASE_URL=postgresql://lowisko:lowisko@localhost:5432/lowisko JWT_ACCESS_SECRET="$(openssl rand -hex 32)" SMTP_URL=smtp://localhost:1025 MAIL_FROM='Łowisko <no-reply@lowisko.test>' exec pnpm --filter api dev
